## Propagating a change to the other agents

The editable skill source is `agent-workflows/skills/` in the owning repository.
Any agent can edit that source within authorized scope. Installed runtime files
are not the source of truth.

**One product installer: Control Tower.** Tower installs its V1 skill roster in
`~/.agents/skills/`, Claude links, the central plan-naming convention, Radar,
Claude signature hooks and registration, Pi notices and the global pointer.
The complete workflow belongs in each adopted project's `AGENTS.md`, not in a
second global workflow block. Use Tower's release/update process for these assets.

**Personal configuration only: `tools/install.py`.** It installs the remaining
active non-V1 skill, `chanks-0-agente-soporte`, and the four personal Chanks blocks.
It also installs the `main-al-dia` freshness launcher to `~/.local/bin/`, like `carril`.
The five deferred skills remain uninstalled; existing copies are archived as
before. It never replaces or deletes Tower files.
Gentle AI assets are managed independently by `gentle-ai`; this repository never
copies, replaces or synchronizes them. Third-party skills are outside its roster.

| Agent | Personal instructions | Installed skills |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Relative links to `~/.agents/skills/` |
| Codex | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` | Native central discovery |
| OpenCode | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | Native central discovery |
| Pi | `~/.pi/agent/APPEND_SYSTEM.md` | Native central discovery |
| Hermes | `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | Separately authorized central discovery; outside this migration |

1. **Prepare in the repository.** Edit only authorized sources/templates.
2. **Ask before installing.** Source edits never authorize personal runtime writes
   or restarts. Explain affected files and obtain maintainer authorization.
3. **Migrate old blocks once.** Inspect `python3 agent-workflows/tools/install.py
   --migrate-to-tower` first; only then authorize the same command with `--apply`.
   Timestamped backups precede every edit. Superseded global routing/plan-naming
   blocks are removed; only the four personal blocks get Chanks markers.
4. **Install and verify by owner.** Tower updates product assets. For personal
   changes run `python3 agent-workflows/tools/install.py`, then `--check`.
   Never delete and recopy runtime directories. Verify protected bytes unchanged.
5. **Protect restore snapshots.** The review-lifecycle-policy block is managed by
   `~/.claude/.skill-backups/manual-blocks.py` and is out of scope. Inspect snapshot
   drift before refreshing anything; never restore an old snapshot over corrected
   instructions. Preserve historical backups and test fresh conversations per agent.

Project rules stay in the project's `AGENTS.md`. Never quote complete managed
marker tags inside a personal block. Source tests prove neither live installation
nor fresh-session loading.
